tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This document will be updated once a decision is recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded, and it names no codec.

I chose that because Muninn's list of current decisions has no compression entry. `muninn why` said the record was insufficient. The only compression material is two raw session exchanges, first "gzip" and then "zstd". Each is a bare one-word user reply, and neither was ever recorded as a decision. Record #26, which `muninn show` reports as retired, may have been the compression decision, but I couldn't read its contents to confirm.

If "zstd" is the actual decision, tell me and I'll update the file.
